Recorded claim:
`mail/base/content/state/store.mjs` `storeObserver` subscribes to the shared store, calls `applyInitialState()` on connection, and invokes `handleStateChange()` when selected values change. Bind `getCalendarEventDialogStateSelectors(sessionKey)` to a stable session key; cache presentation values from observer transitions rather than exposing `sourceState`, `sourceEvent`, or `showPromise` getters backed by `store.getState()`. [Task 3]
